## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD3: full chain exhaustion produces a fallback_exhausted JSON entry conformant to
  docs/contracts/ci-review-fallback-exhausted.md; the entry is written atomically
  (temp + rename) and surviving agents' partial findings are preserved

## Context (from completion verifier DD3 FAIL)
runner.py uses plain open(output_path, "w") for writing findings. DD3 explicitly requires
atomic write (temp file + rename). Neither runner.py nor dispatch.py implement the
temp+rename pattern. The contract doc also does not document per-agent file ownership for
parallel-write safety in deep-tier (3 specialists + arch synthesis) scenarios.

## Implementation

### runner.py atomic write fix
Replace _write_output() function in runner.py to use atomic temp+rename:
```python
import tempfile
import os

def _write_output(data: dict) -> None:
    serialized = json.dumps(data, indent=2)
    output_path = os.environ.get("DSO_CI_REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH")
    if output_path:
        # Atomic write: write to temp file in same directory, then rename
        dir_path = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(output_path))
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
            mode="w", dir=dir_path, suffix=".tmp", delete=False, encoding="utf-8"
        ) as tmp:
            tmp.write(serialized)
            tmp_path = tmp.name
        os.replace(tmp_path, output_path)  # atomic on POSIX
    else:
        print(serialized)
```

### Contract doc update
Update plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ci-review-fallback-exhausted.md to add a "Per-Agent File Ownership" section documenting:
- Each specialist agent (correctness, verification, hygiene) writes to a separate slot file
- arch synthesis agent reads all slot files and writes the merged result atomically
- Prevents parallel-write corruption in deep-tier dispatch

### Test update
Update tests/skills/dso_ci_review/ to assert atomic write behavior:
- Given: DSO_CI_REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH set to a target path
- When: runner.main() is called with valid diff
- Then: output file exists at the target path with valid JSON (proves atomic write completed)
Existing test_runner_smoke.py exercises the output path — update it to verify file contents.

Files to modify:
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py
- plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ci-review-fallback-exhausted.md

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: cd plugins/dso/scripts && poetry run pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/ -v 2>/dev/null | tail -10
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py
- [ ] Atomic write implemented in runner.py
  Verify: grep -q "os.replace\|os.rename" plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py
- [ ] No plain open(path, "w") for output in runner.py
  Verify: ! grep -qE 'open\(output_path.*"w"\)' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py
- [ ] Contract doc has per-agent file ownership section
  Verify: grep -qi "per-agent\|file.*ownership\|slot file" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ci-review-fallback-exhausted.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
